The '''H'relac system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
The [[Unidentified H'relac species|natives]] of this system fought to maintain their freedom when an alliance of corporations tried to take control of the system, around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="WttJ">{{GamerCite|6|Welcome to the Jungle}}</ref>
